tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open tech jobs by keywords, place, skills, level, work type, visa sponsorship, pay and posting date. Returns 20 jobs a page, newest first, or the best title matches first when there are keywords. Each job has `url` (its CareerHolo page) and `apply_url` (the company's own page).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job's details by the id search_jobs gives: whether it is still open, the description (in full where the source allows, else an excerpt), skills, pay, work type and the links.

tools.name: match_my_skills
tools.description: Rank open tech jobs by how well they fit a person's skills, the way CareerHolo's resume match does: a match percentage for each job, the skills they have and miss, and which skill to learn next for more jobs. Send skills only - never a name, email or the resume's text. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: salary_for
tools.description: The median and typical range of stated pay for a tech role in a place, from open postings, in US dollars a year. Roles: Software, Backend, Frontend, Full Stack, Data, DevOps, Site Reliability, Machine Learning, Mobile, iOS, Android and Security Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Product Manager

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: One employer's open tech jobs, 20 a page, with how many it has open, the skills it hires for and its median stated pay.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, match_my_skills · Public sink: match_my_skills.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, match_my_skills · Public sink: match_my_skills

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
